--benchmark-dir.help: Path to the benchmark directory containing model subdirectories

--debug.help: Use debug build instead of release build

--delete.help: remove local runs that no longer exist on the remote

--goose-profile.help: Goose profile directory to copy into the benchmark container. Accepts either a GOOSE_PATH_ROOT-style directory or a config directory containing config.yaml.

--install-goose-runtime-deps.help: Install minimal OS runtime dependencies required by some Goose release binaries inside Debian/Ubuntu task containers.

--jobs.help: restrict to specific job names (default: all runs)

--leaderboard-output.help: Output filename for the leaderboard (default: leaderboard.csv)

--no-install-goose-runtime-deps.help: skip apt-get install libgomp1 inside the task container

--pr.help: Release PR number (if omitted, searches for open release PRs)

--prompt-file.help: Path to custom evaluation prompt file

--suites.help: Comma-separated list of benchmark suites to run (e.g., 'core,small_models')

--tail.help: tail N lines of the agent log

--tasks.help: comma-separated task names (default: all tasks in dataset)

--union-output.help: Output filename for the union of all CSVs (default: all_metrics.csv)

goose_binary.help: path to the goose binary to test

list.help: list all runs with summary stats

output_file.help: Name of the output file to evaluate (e.g., blog_summary_output.txt)

pull.help: rsync runs from a remote machine

task.help: full detail for one task in one run
